articles.title: Governor Lawal: The banker who won’t borrow, By Karen Ibrahim
articles.summary:
Governor Lawal’s fiscal approach offers a compelling blueprint for sub-national governance across Nigeria. The most credible assessment of his tenure thus far is that Zamfara has achieved measurable progress in both revenue mobilization, debt reduction and project execution.
The post Governor Lawal: The banker who won’t borrow, By Karen Ibrahim appeared first on Premium Times Nigeria.
articles.hausa_translation: Gwamna Lawal: Jajere wanda ba ya rance. Hanyar kuɗi ta Gwamna Lawal tana ba da tsarin gida mai inganci ga kakakin rikici a Nijeriya. Mafi inganci ainihin daidaita aikinsa har yanzu shine Zamfara ta sami ci gaba a tattare da haɓakawa jari, rage jari da aiwatar da aikiyi.
critical_questions: What specific revenue mobilization metrics and debt reduction figures are cited, and how do they compare to baseline data before Lawal's tenure?

articles.title: Two arrested over alleged plot to kidnap Kano village head

The suspects, Aliyu Naziru Garba, 20, and Bashir Alhasan, 20, were arrested following an intelligence-led operation triggered by a report from the traditional ruler, Mallam Idris, […]
